explanation: Aksum traded ivory and gold across the Red Sea and minted its own coins. King Ezana adopted Christianity in the 300s AD, and his later coins bear a cross.

King Ezana of Aksum adopted Christianity in the 300s AD, and crosses appear on his later coins.
